name: GTG-50029
brief: A single-person operation that targeted European political parties, media outlets, think-tanks, and the SaaS providers used by these organizations, and built a mass doxxing/lookup platform ("fafsearch") loaded with tens of millions of rows including national health identifiers and justice-system-breach data. Used a custom Rust-based scanner (with proxy-based key rotation) to find exposed API keys, an AI-managed sub-agent framework for pre/post-auth reconnaissance, exploitation of an undocumented WordPress reinstall race condition (4 victim sites), webshells, a malicious must-use WordPress plugin for credential harvesting, backup poisoning for persistence, and a browser-exploitation C2 injected into a media outlet's reader-facing script. Anthropic: "one of the clearest cases we have seen of AI-assisted software engineering applied directly to a mass attack on privacy—and the entire platform was created by just one person." 42 tracked targets, internal access to 14, 12–26GB exfiltrated.
